trust_decision.summary: Only fields from a message's header section may enter req->input_headers, which evhttp_validate_len_and_encoding_ checks once in evhttp_read_header; before the fix, chunked-body trailer fields (and obs-fold lines continuing the last validated header) were parsed into the same list after that check, and then used for keep-alive decisions and by the application.

landing_point.why: The advisory is about header smuggling through trailers; evhttp_read_trailer is the only trailer handler and calls evhttp_parse_headers_, which writes into req->input_headers.

fix_sites.entry_point: server: incoming request with chunked body accepted by evhttp_bind_socket/evhttp_accept_socket; client: chunked response to evhttp_make_request
fix_sites.module_kind: core HTTP/1.x parser (connection read state machine)

fix_sites.entry_point: same parser; refactored into evhttp_parse_headers_impl_ with a caller-supplied header list, plus a wrapper evhttp_parse_headers_ (fix.diff:83-96, fix.diff:112-116)
fix_sites.module_kind: internal helper (refactor, no behaviour change on header path)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both 'Discard trailers' commits (fix.diff:39-120 and fix.diff:122-203) are the same change applied to two branches; the other two commits only touch test/regress_http.c. All source changes are in http.c.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 route: a 100 Continue response is an interim, server-sent, client-side message, and the advisory talks about trailers, so 'interim response headers are not trailers and the client trusts its server' is an easy argument.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Chunked messages that carry trailers must still be fully read and completed (the connection moves to done and can stay keep-alive). An over-broad fix that fails the connection on any trailer line, or rejects obs-fold continuation lines in the real header section, breaks legitimate traffic.

O6_input_shapes: a new trailer field line, such as Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding or Connection, appended to input_headers after validation (http.c:2164)
an obs-fold continuation line at the start of the trailer section that extended the last validated header's value (http.c:2148-2149, http.c:2093); after the fix it fails because tmp_headers is empty
both directions: request trailers on the server side and response trailers on the client side (http.c:1057, http.c:1159)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client side: headers from a 100 Continue interim response stay in req->input_headers, and the final response's headers are appended to them, because nothing clears the list before the next firstline is read. Validation and body framing then see the union of both messages.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Interim response rather than trailers; client-side; the server is trusted; validation does run again on the union.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 1500 lines from the landing point (evhttp_read_header 100 branch -> evhttp_write_connectioncb http.c:1197-1214 -> evhttp_start_read_ http.c:2885-2903, none of which clears input_headers)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A public accessor or chunk callback path that exposes trailers by merging them into input_headers, e.g. 'evhttp_request_get_input_trailers' implemented as a merge
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Trailers are an obvious feature request, and merging into the existing list is the least-effort design.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The 100 Continue restart path reusing input_headers across messages (already present; it could be made more direct by skipping re-validation)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer restarting the read state machine reuses the request object without thinking about its accumulated header list.

O9_family: HTTP request/response smuggling (CWE-444): message fields merged into the validated header set after framing validation

O10_build.toolchain: CMake or autotools, C compiler; optional OpenSSL/mbedTLS/zlib
O10_build.project_tests: test/regress_http.c (regress binary, http/* suite, including http_check_transfer_encoding_test at test/regress_http.c:3982-3985); the fix adds no trailer test

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject or skip only Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding trailer fields by name, leaving other trailer fields (Connection, Host) and the leading obs-fold continuation that rewrites a validated header.

out_of_scope_notes: evhttp_parse_headers_ splits key/value with strsep on ':' and does not reject whitespace before the colon or empty keys (http.c:2157-2165); this concerns header-name validation, not trailers.
The XXX overflow comments at http.c:1083 and http.c:1098 concern body length handling, not this advisory.
